description: Org-wide policy for published KMP libraries — automerge baseline, 3-day soak, kotlin-toolchain and first-party holds. See meshtastic/.github:kmp-library.json for the rules and their rationale. The org.meshtastic:protobufs dependency is a Maven artifact here (the git submodule was removed in #50), so the preset's first-party hold governs it. The one local rule pins konsist.

packageRules.description: konsist 0.18 ships JVM 17+ variants only, and jvmTest compiles against the library's JVM 11 toolchain.
